items.title: China's Xpeng wants to put an eerily friendly humanoid robot in your home for the same price as an affordable EV
items.excerpt: At its Nov 25 AI Day, XPeng showed the latest IRON humanoid (76 DoF, 1,500+ tactile points, three in-house Turing AI chips running onboard models) answering questions live; it targets a 2027 launch at a price comparable to an EV, with household use on the roadmap.
items.note: robotics cap 1: home-roadmap humanoid, price framed as EV-comparable, 2027 launch

items.title: Ray-Ban and Oakley Meta AI glasses are coming to SA
items.excerpt: EssilorLuxottica and Meta are bringing Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta AI glasses to South Africa from end of November - Meta's first African market - with local pricing (Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 R8,599, Oakley Meta HSTN R8,399, Vanguard R10,599) and built-in Meta AI for asking about what you see.

items.title: HP코리아, AI PC '옴니북 울트라 16' 국내 출시
items.excerpt: HP Korea launched the OmniBook Ultra 16 on Nov 24, built on Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X platform (20-core Grace CPU, 6,144-core Blackwell GPU, up to 128GB unified memory) to run large AI models locally without the cloud and drive multi-step AI agents.

items.title: USC engineers built a smart ring that monitors stress by taking a peek at your sweat glands
items.excerpt: A USC team's smart ring uses near-infrared light to read sweat-gland activity and runs a 27.65kB INT8 stress model entirely on the ring's microcontroller, cutting post-sensing delay ~300x (9.9s to 33ms) versus streaming raw data (Science Advances).
items.note: research prototype, non-Oura smart ring, on-device AI

items.title: Meta is staring at a smart glasses ban in another country over privacy fears
items.excerpt: Dutch consumer association Consumentenbond and Offlimits filed legal action seeking to halt Ray-Ban Meta sales unless Meta prevents covert recording and stops using captured footage to train AI models; Meta and EssilorLuxottica deny EU-law violations.
items.note: follow-up to 11-24 Dutch DPA item; new action is a consumer-group lawsuit, not a regulator decision - likely capped
